name: payin-cloud-layer
description: Spike showing a PayIn Cloud overlay composed on payin-open without forking payment core.

scripts.validate: npm run build:open-api && npm run type-check && npm run build && npm run build:admin && npm run safety:scan
scripts.smoke:policy: npm run build && npm run smoke:runtime
scripts.control-plane:db:migrate: npm run build && node scripts/control-plane-postgres.mjs migrate
scripts.control-plane:db:check: npm run build && node scripts/control-plane-postgres.mjs check
